heroText: Linköping works best as a base in Sweden when you anchor days around Gamla Linkoping, Linkoping Cathedral and Air Force Museum. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Linköping City Airport (LPI) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: Historically, Linköping is famed for being an early diocese, c. 1082, second in Sweden (within its pre-1658 boundaries) only to Skara.

history.label: 12th century
history.text: The monastery of Vreta Kloster near Roxen north of Linköping was established in 1128, and the oldest parts of the cathedral are also from the 12th century (although it has been changed many times since then, the eye-catching tower with copper roofing being a 19th-century product).
On several occasions attempts to achieve a separate Swedish archdiocese were based in Linköping, although, when they finally were successful in 1164, Uppsala was chosen instead.
The coronation of Valdemar Birgersson took place in the cathedral in 1251.
A cathedral school can be traced from 1266. In 1627 the current Linköping cathedral school was established, making it the third oldest gymnasium in Sweden.

Linköping was a small town until 1937, when the Saab aircraft industry was formed, starting a period of rapid expansion.
In 2022, a rare Viking grave was found in Linköping that seemed to mark the Viking transition from paganism to Christianity.
